wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Numan Registry project overview. Explain its purpose as a specialized package registry for Nushell, its role in the Nushell ecosystem, and how it differs from other package managers. Document the project's architecture at a high level, including the relationship between registry index, signing mechanisms, and validation tools. Provide context about why this registry exists and what problems it solves. Include both conceptual overviews for newcomers to Nushell package management and technical details for experienced developers. Use terminology consistent with the codebase such as 'packages', 'plugins', 'scripts', and 'registry'. Make the content accessible while establishing the foundation for understanding the system's security model and distribution workflow.

wiki_catalogs.name: Package Structure and Organization
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for package structure and organization in the Numan Registry ecosystem. Explain the required directory layout, file naming conventions, and organizational patterns for different package types (plugins, scripts, utilities). Document how packages should be structured within archives, including entry points, dependencies, and metadata files. Provide concrete examples from actual package specs showing proper organization for Nushell plugins, standalone scripts, and utility packages. Include guidelines for handling binary vs script-based packages, documentation placement, and test organization. Address best practices for maintaining clean package structure and avoiding common organizational pitfalls.

wiki_catalogs.name: Getting Started
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive getting started content for the Numan Registry. Include installation instructions for setting up the development environment, required dependencies (Python, Rust toolchain), and initial configuration steps. Provide step-by-step instructions for adding your first package to the registry, including creating a valid package manifest, running validation checks, and submitting changes. Include basic usage examples demonstrating common workflows like package validation, signature verification, and registry updates. Document the minimum requirements and prerequisites needed to work with the registry. Address common setup issues and provide troubleshooting tips for new users. Make the content beginner-friendly while ensuring all necessary technical details are covered.

wiki_catalogs.name: Manifest Format Specification
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the package manifest format specification. Thoroughly explain all required and optional fields in the JSON manifest schema, including field types, validation rules, and constraints. Document the relationship between manifest fields and registry index schema requirements. Provide comprehensive examples showing valid manifests for different package types with explanations of each field's purpose. Include guidance on versioning strategies, dependency declarations, and metadata best practices. Address common manifest errors and validation failures with troubleshooting guidance. Make content accessible to beginners while providing sufficient technical depth for experienced package authors.

wiki_catalogs.name: Package Development Guide
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for package development in the Numan Registry ecosystem. Thoroughly explain the package structure, manifest format specification, and required fields. Document the different types of packages supported (plugins, scripts, utilities) with concrete examples from the actual specs directory. Include best practices for package organization, versioning strategies, and naming conventions. Explain the relationship between package manifests and the registry index schema. Provide guidance on testing packages locally before submission, including validation using the provided tools. Document common patterns for dependency management and compatibility considerations. Address packaging guidelines for different file types and archive formats. Make content accessible to beginners while providing sufficient technical depth for experienced package authors.

wiki_catalogs.name: Package Validation and Testing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for package validation and testing processes. Document the validation pipeline including manifest schema validation, archive format verification, and signature checking. Explain how to use the provided validation tools locally before submission, including command-line usage and expected outputs. Detail the linting process for manifest consistency and registry index compliance. Include troubleshooting guides for common validation errors and their solutions. Document testing strategies for package functionality, compatibility checks, and integration testing. Address performance considerations and optimization tips for large packages or complex dependency trees.

wiki_catalogs.name: Registry Operations
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for registry operations and maintenance. Detail the process of adding new packages to the registry, updating existing entries, and removing deprecated packages. Explain the registry index structure and how it maintains package metadata. Document the linting and validation processes that ensure registry integrity. Include procedures for handling package conflicts, version management, and rollback scenarios. Provide guidance on maintaining registry consistency and performance optimization. Address backup and recovery procedures for the registry data. Document the relationship between the registry index and individual package specifications. Include troubleshooting common registry operation issues and their solutions.

wiki_catalogs.name: Package Publishing Workflow
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the complete package publishing workflow. Explain the step-by-step process from package preparation to registry publication, including local validation, manifest creation, and archive generation. Document the contribution process using pull requests, code review requirements, and approval workflows. Include guidance on signing packages, managing versions, and handling updates. Address release management strategies, backward compatibility considerations, and deprecation policies. Provide troubleshooting guidance for common publishing issues and rollback procedures. Document best practices for maintaining package quality and community standards.

wiki_catalogs.name: Security and Signing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for security and cryptographic signing in the Numan Registry. Thoroughly explain the digital signature system used to verify package authenticity and integrity. Document key management procedures including key generation, storage, rotation, and revocation. Explain the signing process during CI/CD pipelines and manual signing workflows. Include detailed instructions for verifying package signatures and detecting tampering. Document security best practices for key handling and access control. Address incident response procedures for compromised keys or packages. Provide guidance on implementing custom signing algorithms if needed. Include troubleshooting common signing and verification issues. Make the content suitable for security-conscious developers and system administrators.

wiki_catalogs.name: Lifecycle Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for package lifecycle management in the Numan Registry. Detail the different stages of a package's lifecycle from creation to deprecation, including evidence tracking and compliance requirements. Explain the lifecycle proof system and how it ensures package integrity throughout its existence. Document the automated tools for generating and verifying lifecycle evidence. Include procedures for transitioning packages between lifecycle states and handling exceptions. Address version compatibility management and migration strategies. Provide guidance on monitoring package health and identifying outdated or problematic packages. Document the relationship between lifecycle stages and registry visibility. Include troubleshooting lifecycle-related issues and their resolutions.

wiki_catalogs.name: CI/CD Integration
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for CI/CD integration with the Numan Registry. Document the GitHub Actions workflows used for automated package validation, signing, and registry updates. Explain the preflight checks and safety measures implemented in the automation pipeline. Include setup instructions for integrating custom CI/CD pipelines with the registry. Document the production cutover process and deployment strategies. Address environment configuration, secret management, and access control in CI/CD contexts. Provide guidance on debugging failed CI/CD runs and optimizing pipeline performance. Include best practices for maintaining reliable automation and handling edge cases. Document the relationship between CI/CD stages and registry operations.

wiki_catalogs.name: API Reference
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive API documentation for the Numan Registry's programmatic interfaces. Document all Python scripts as command-line APIs, including their parameters, options, return codes, and error handling. For the validate script, detail input validation rules, supported package formats, and output schemas. Document the version constraint checking API and its integration with Nushell version management. Explain the archive format handling API and supported compression methods. Include examples of programmatic usage, error handling patterns, and integration with external tools. Document any JSON schemas used for configuration and data exchange. Provide guidance on extending the API with custom validators and formatters. Address performance considerations and best practices for API usage.

wiki_catalogs.name: Troubleshooting
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive troubleshooting documentation for common issues encountered when working with the Numan Registry. Document diagnostic procedures for package validation failures, signing errors, and registry synchronization problems. Include detailed error message explanations and their resolutions. Provide guidance on debugging CI/CD pipeline failures and automation issues. Document the secret scanning tool and procedures for addressing security findings. Include performance troubleshooting for slow registry operations and large package handling. Address network connectivity issues and mirror synchronization problems. Provide step-by-step guides for investigating and resolving incidents using the documented procedures. Include escalation paths and contact information for critical issues. Make the content actionable with clear problem identification and resolution steps.

wiki_catalogs.name: Contributing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive contributing documentation for developers who want to contribute to the Numan Registry project. Document the development environment setup, coding standards, and testing procedures. Explain the pull request workflow, code review process, and merge criteria. Include guidelines for writing tests, particularly for the validation and linting scripts. Document the release process and versioning strategy. Address documentation standards and how to update existing docs. Provide guidance on reporting bugs and requesting features. Include information about community guidelines and communication channels. Document the testing framework and how to run the existing test suite. Address security considerations for contributions and responsible disclosure procedures.

wiki_catalogs.name: Tools and Utilities
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the standalone tools and utilities provided with the Numan Registry. Document the parser checker tool built in Rust, including its purpose, compilation process, and usage patterns. Explain the mirror building utility for creating local copies of the registry. Document the intake candidate synchronization tool and its role in package onboarding. Include installation instructions for each tool and their dependencies. Provide usage examples and common workflows for each utility. Address configuration options and customization possibilities. Document the relationship between these tools and the main registry system. Include troubleshooting guides for tool-specific issues and performance optimization tips.

wiki_catalogs.name: Outreach and Community
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for outreach activities and community engagement related to the Numan Registry. Document the process for reaching out to upstream projects for package adoption and integration. Explain the intake candidate evaluation process and criteria for package acceptance. Include guidelines for community outreach, communication templates, and follow-up procedures. Document the relationship between the registry and the broader Nushell community. Address strategies for encouraging package contributions and maintaining community engagement. Provide guidance on handling community feedback and feature requests. Include information about community events, meetings, and collaboration opportunities. Document the process for becoming a package maintainer and contributing to the registry governance.
